UPDATE account_groups g SET index = s.index
        FROM (
            SELECT o.id, p.index
            FROM unnest($1::uuid[]) WITH ORDINALITY AS o(id, pos)
            JOIN (
                SELECT index, row_number() OVER (ORDER BY index, id) AS pos
                FROM account_groups WHERE id = ANY($1)
            ) p ON p.pos = o.pos
        ) s WHERE g.id = s.id
